name: Build No. 001 Tee
summary: Build No. 001, off the build sheet and onto a shirt.  A 1970s German sedan pushed one step further: S54 inline six swap, custom widebody, coilovers and a riveted aluminum splitter, with "Custom Build" and "Project Car" in Japanese down the side.
